before.title: 1.0 T-GDI Turbocharger Defect — RPM Rises but Car Won't Accelerate
before.description: Casper 1.0 T-GDI (turbo) owners reported a sudden loss of acceleration, typically at 70–80 km/h: the engine revs climb but the car will not accelerate past roughly 80–85 km/h, sometimes with a check-engine light. In some cars the symptom cleared after an ignition cycle; in others it persisted. More than 10 complaints reached Korea's Automobile Recall Center within a month in late 2023, concentrated in turbo cars built around April–June 2023 (many sold through inventory-clearance promotions). According to an owner briefed on the joint investigation by Hyundai's research center and the parts supplier, the conclusion was a defective turbocharger, and replacing the turbocharger eliminated the symptom. Naturally aspirated 1.0 MPI cars were not affected.
before.solution: Have the turbocharger inspected and replaced — replacement resolved the symptom in reported cases, and affected vehicles were repaired under Hyundai's 5-year/100,000 km powertrain warranty in Korea. Document the symptom (dashcam or scan-tool freeze frame helps) since it can be intermittent, and report it to the service center so the turbocharger, boost-control actuator, and related fault codes are checked rather than just clearing the warning light.
symptoms: RPM rises but speed will not increase past about 80 km/h
Noticeable loss of power during highway merging or passing
Check engine light during the episode
Symptom sometimes clears after restarting the engine
Weak or absent turbo boost feel

before.title: Casper Electric 3-Way Coolant Valve Failure — Fire Risk Recall
before.description: The Casper Electric (AX1 EV) uses a 3-way valve to switch coolant flow between the heating/cooling circuits. A design deficiency allows the valve's internal shaft to break, which can cause improper coolant circulation, intermittent air-conditioning failure, coolant leaks, and in the worst case an electrical short with smoke and fire. Hyundai first ran a free-repair campaign in 2025 covering 11,649 cars built 16 Jul 2024–10 Feb 2025, but problems persisted (including o-ring leaks after the repair), and on 12 May 2026 the company escalated to a full safety recall of all 18,961 Casper Electrics sold in Korea (production 21 Jun 2024–24 Apr 2026). Owner communities also reported parts shortages and long waits before the recall was announced.
before.solution: Have the recall performed: Hyundai service centers replace the 3-way valve with an improved part free of charge (about 1 hour 40 minutes to 2 hours of work). If a coolant warning light or leak persists after the repair, return to the service center — Hyundai issued guidance to technicians about proper o-ring seating during valve replacement. Check recall eligibility at car.go.kr or a Hyundai Bluehands center using the VIN.
symptoms: Coolant or EV system warning light during driving
Air conditioning or heating intermittently stops working
Coolant leak under the front of the car
Steam or burning smell from the front compartment
Smoke in severe cases

before.title: Casper Electric Coolant Hub Drive Module Defect — EWP Warning Light
before.description: A separate cooling-system defect from the 3-way valve: an internal fault in the coolant hub drive module on Casper Electrics built 28 Feb 2024–16 Apr 2025 (12,004 vehicles) causes the electric water pump (EWP) warning light to illuminate while driving. The defect was announced alongside the ICCU action as part of Hyundai's ~25,600-vehicle Casper EV free-repair program in September 2025. Owner reports collected by Korean press also describe drive-motor coolant warnings and coolant loss around the motor-side water pump on some cars, so any cooling warning on a Casper Electric should be checked promptly to protect the drive motor and battery thermal management.
before.solution: Hyundai replaces the coolant hub drive module free of charge under the service campaign. Owners should not ignore the EWP warning — reduced coolant circulation can affect drive-motor and battery cooling. Verify campaign eligibility by VIN at car.go.kr or a Hyundai service center, and have any coolant loss around the motor-side water pump inspected at the same visit.
symptoms: Electric water pump (EWP) warning light while driving
Drive motor coolant warning message
Low coolant level without visible cause
Repeated warnings after a previous cooling-system repair

before.title: Casper Electric ICCU Failure — Slow Charging Stops Working
before.description: The Casper Electric inherited the Hyundai Motor Group ICCU (Integrated Charging Control Unit) problem already seen on the Ioniq 5/6 and Kia EV6. Internal failures occur intermittently — particularly after using the V2L (vehicle-to-load) external power function — and the car then refuses to AC slow-charge normally. Hyundai announced a recall/free-repair action covering 13,587 Casper Electrics produced 16 Jul 2024–22 Aug 2025, with service work starting 5 Sep 2025 as part of a roughly 25,600-vehicle Casper EV service push. The wider Hyundai/Kia ICCU defect has generated complaints and petitions in Korea because a failed ICCU can leave the 12V system without charge.
before.solution: Under the recall, Hyundai service centers run fault-code diagnosis and a charging check, then apply an ICCU software update or replace the ICCU (and related fuse/components) free of charge. Out of warranty, ICCU replacement is an expensive repair, so affected owners should confirm campaign eligibility by VIN at car.go.kr or a Hyundai service center before paying for any repair.
symptoms: AC (slow) charging fails to start or stops mid-session
Charging works at DC fast chargers but not on a home/slow charger
Failure appears after using the V2L external power function
EV system or charging warning light on the cluster
12V battery discharge warning in severe cases

before.title: Rainwater Leak Into Passenger Footwell Through Cowl Air Intake
before.description: 2021–2022 Caspers let rainwater into the cabin on the passenger side. The external air-intake (cowl) cover at the base of the windshield drains poorly, so in heavy rain water gets past it and enters through the cabin air filter area, soaking the filter and, in worse cases, pooling on the passenger-side floor mat — even on parked cars. Around 50 complaints reached Korea's Automobile Recall Center in just the first 12 days of August 2022, with simultaneous reports across Casper owner forums. Hyundai completed its investigation and ran a free-repair campaign from late August/September 2022, replacing the relevant components, alongside the idle-vibration campaign.
before.solution: Have Hyundai's free-repair campaign performed (replacement of the air-intake/cowl components to restore drainage). After the repair, replace the cabin air filter if it was soaked and dry the carpet to prevent mold and musty odor. Owners of early cars who notice dampness on the passenger side after rain should check whether the campaign was already applied to their VIN.
symptoms: Wet passenger-side floor mat after rain
Water dripping from behind the glovebox/cabin filter area
Damp or musty smell when the HVAC fan runs
Soaked cabin air filter
Water entry even while parked in heavy rain

before.title: Severe Idle Vibration When A/C and Rear Defroster Run Together
before.description: Early gasoline Caspers (2021–2022) shook noticeably at idle — owners described it as "someone rocking the car" — with engine RPM fluctuating between roughly 700 and 900 rpm. The shaking appears mainly when the air conditioner and heated rear glass (and sometimes headlights or wipers) run simultaneously, and is worse on rainy days. About 100 defect reports were filed with the Korea Transportation Safety Authority in July 2022 alone, and roughly 350 total Casper complaints landed in July–August 2022. Hyundai's investigation found the electrical system was being overloaded when multiple high-draw accessories ran at low idle (generator/battery capacity marginal for the load), and the company announced a free-repair campaign from around September 2022 using an ECU software update that rebalances electrical power distribution.
before.solution: Apply Hyundai's free-repair campaign: an ECU (and related controller) software update that adjusts power-supply distribution under combined electrical loads. Any Hyundai service center can check whether the update has been applied. If severe vibration persists after the update, have the battery state of charge, alternator output, and engine mounts checked.
symptoms: Car shakes strongly at idle with A/C and rear defroster on
Idle RPM fluctuates between about 700 and 900 rpm
Vibration worsens on rainy days or with headlights/wipers on
Vibration felt both stopped and at low speed

proposal.title: Severe Idle Vibration When A/C and Rear Defroster Run Together
proposal.description: Early gasoline Caspers (2021–2022) shook noticeably at idle — owners described it as "someone rocking the car" — with engine RPM fluctuating between roughly 700 and 900 rpm. The shaking appears mainly when the air conditioner and heated rear glass (and sometimes headlights or wipers) run simultaneously, and is worse on rainy days. About 100 defect reports were filed with the Korea Transportation Safety Authority in July 2022 alone, and roughly 350 total Casper complaints landed in July–August 2022. Hyundai's investigation found the electrical system was being overloaded when multiple high-draw accessories ran at low idle (generator/battery capacity marginal for the load), and the company announced a free-repair campaign from around September 2022 using an ECU software update that rebalances electrical power distribution.
proposal.solution: Apply Hyundai's free-repair campaign: an ECU (and related controller) software update that adjusts power-supply distribution under combined electrical loads. Any Hyundai service center can check whether the update has been applied. If severe vibration persists after the update, have the battery state of charge, alternator output, and engine mounts checked.
symptoms: Car shakes strongly at idle with A/C and rear defroster on
Idle RPM fluctuates between about 700 and 900 rpm
Vibration worsens on rainy days or with headlights/wipers on
Vibration felt both stopped and at low speed
